reason.description: Factual reason for the branch actually reached; never placeholder, test, TBD, N/A, unknown or null. Call ONLY in the same response as, and after, a nonempty spoken closing <message>; a tool-only Complete is invalid. A pending question blocks Complete unless its defined terminal outcome is reached. UPI availability: after original plus two re-prompts with no clear yes/no, use the NO-VALID-RSP closing and Complete (never Step 6). UPI capture/readback or first-name gates: if the caller SPOKE but no usable answer came after original plus two re-prompts, go to Step 6 instead of Complete; only silence/noise on all three asks may use the NO-VALID-RSP closing. A direct live-agent request with unknown purpose must first run its purpose gate. Active speech or partial transcripts block terminal execution. Silence, speech-recognition uncertainty, an agent request, UserNotRegistered or InvalidIdentifier is not a technical failure.

VerificationStatus.description: Authenticated for trusted registered-phone match, or current UPI match plus first-name confirmation. Otherwise Unauthenticated.

CallSummary.description: ONE factual sentence (about 25 words) composed in this terminal turn: identity path, domain/sub-intent, key answers, outcome and next step. Only facts the caller said; never placeholder text, password, PIN, code, UPI value or the '|' character. For question exhaustion, name the unanswered gate.

Email.description: Held AbbVie email (CALL CONTEXT when Matched, or current UserLookUp). Empty if unverified.

LanguageDetected.description: Current spoken language as one bare BCP-47 code (en-US, hi-IN, es-MX, pt-BR). Fallback initial_language_name, then en-US.

UserId.description: Held ServiceNow UserId. Empty if unverified.

Intent.description: Exactly one allowed label for the branch actually reached. Teams receipt not confirmed keeps the TechSpot case label.
